article.title: Party receiving must transmit notice of dishonour.
article.content: Any party receiving notice of dishonour must, in order to render any prior party liable to himself, give notice of dishonour to such party within a reasonable time, unless such party otherwise receives due notice as provided by section 93.
article.html:
95Party receiving must transmit notice of dishonour.

Section 95 · Chapter VIII · page 22 of the Act

Any party receiving notice of dishonour must, in order to render any prior party liable to himself, give notice of dishonour to such party within a reasonable time, unless such party otherwise receives due notice as provided by section 93.
